about: The shared vocabulary for comparing two designs. Every design, yours or ours, answers the same short list of questions (what colour is the main button, how round are the corners, ...). Each answer is a role. A role also says which of this product's design tokens (design/tokens.css) it drives, so a choice made on a role reaches every screen part that uses those tokens.

areas.label: Colours
areas.ask: Which colours should the result use?

areas.label: Type
areas.ask: Which fonts and text sizes should the result use?

areas.label: Corner radius
areas.ask: How round should buttons, inputs, cards and chips be?

areas.label: Control size
areas.ask: How tall should buttons, inputs and menu items be?

roles.label: Main action colour
roles.plain: the colour of the main button

roles.label: Text on the main action colour
roles.plain: the colour of the words on the main button

roles.label: Page background
roles.plain: the colour behind everything

roles.label: Card and panel background
roles.plain: the colour inside cards, panels and the side menu

roles.label: Main text
roles.plain: the colour of ordinary text

roles.label: Quiet text
roles.plain: the colour of captions and hints

roles.label: Card and divider lines
roles.plain: the thin lines round cards and between rows

roles.label: Input outline
roles.plain: the outline of text boxes and buttons

roles.label: Hover background
roles.plain: the colour a row or menu item takes under the pointer

roles.label: Selected background
roles.plain: the colour of the menu item or row that is current

roles.label: Text font
roles.plain: the font of ordinary text

roles.label: Requirement-text font
roles.plain: the font the wording of a requirement is shown in

roles.label: Code font
roles.plain: the font of identifiers and code

roles.label: Text size
roles.plain: the size of ordinary text

roles.label: Small text size
roles.plain: the size of captions and chips

roles.label: Page title size
roles.plain: the size of the title at the top of a page

roles.label: Button and input corners
roles.plain: how round buttons and inputs are

roles.label: Card corners
roles.plain: how round cards and panels are

roles.label: Chip corners
roles.plain: how round small labels (chips, badges) are

roles.label: Card shadow
roles.plain: the shadow under a raised card

roles.label: Control height
roles.plain: how tall a button or input is
